parsed.reason: This is a competent proposal message. It uses correct first-person singular ("Want me to make an intro?"), contains no grammatical errors, and presents a small, specific offer with appropriate reasoning. The message states exactly what was handed to it: the activity title and day ("Rhyme Time at Danforth Library on Tuesday"), the counterpart child's age band ("baby"), and the recipient's own child reference as provided ("your kid's age"). It avoids overselling, doesn't imply unwarranted knowledge about the other family, and asks a genuine yes/no question without demanding a specific response word. The tone is conversational and appropriate to the request size.
